skill.name: azure-resource-visualizer
skill.description: Analyze Azure resource groups and create Mermaid architecture diagrams that show resources, configuration details, and relationships.
skill.summary: Creates Azure resource group architecture documentation with Mermaid diagrams and relationship notes.
skill.author: microsoft

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, Mermaid syntax, and sample private CIDR ranges. The skill guides agents to query Azure resource metadata with Azure tools or az, but the instructions are read-only and prohibit secrets in diagrams. No prompt-injection text or destructive Azure operations were found.

remediation.issue: Azure CLI guidance can enumerate cloud inventory metadata.
remediation.suggestion: Keep Azure CLI examples read-only and require clear user confirmation before running commands against an authenticated tenant.

remediation.issue: Generated architecture files can expose sensitive topology details.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to redact private names, tags, IP ranges, and identity relationships before sharing generated diagrams.

content.value_statement: Azure teams need clear diagrams for resource groups and dependencies. This skill builds Mermaid architecture documents from Azure resource metadata.
actual_capabilities: Lists or validates Azure resource groups before analysis.
Queries resources with Azure MCP tools, Azure CLI, or Azure Resource Graph guidance.
Maps resource relationships across networking, data, identity, and dependencies.
Creates Mermaid diagrams grouped by architecture layer or purpose.
Generates Markdown architecture files with inventory tables, diagrams, notes, and recommendations.
limitations: Requires Azure access through configured tools or Azure CLI credentials.
Cannot guarantee hidden dependencies that are not visible in Azure metadata.
Large environments may need multiple diagrams for readability.
Generated documentation may need review before sharing outside the team.

use_cases.title: Document a Production Resource Group
use_cases.description: Create a readable architecture document for an existing Azure resource group before a review or handoff.

use_cases.title: Map Application Dependencies
use_cases.description: Show how compute, storage, databases, identities, and network resources connect inside an application environment.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Architecture Review
use_cases.description: Generate Mermaid diagrams and relationship notes that help reviewers inspect design, security, and operational dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Diagram
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one known resource group.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Azure architecture diagram for resource group <name>. Include all resources, major relationships, and a short summary.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Resource Group
prompt_templates.scenario: User does not know the exact group name.
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Azure resource groups, ask me to choose one, then generate a Mermaid architecture document for the selected group.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Network and Identity
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate analysis with specific relationship emphasis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze resource group <name> and focus the diagram on VNets, subnets, private endpoints, managed identities, and Key Vault access.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Review Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a complete architecture review document for resource group <name>. Include inventory, layered Mermaid diagrams, relationship details, and operational notes.

output_examples.input: Create a diagram for the payments production resource group.
output_examples.output: A Markdown architecture file with a resource inventory, a layered Mermaid diagram, relationship notes, and review observations.

output_examples.input: Show the network dependencies for my app resource group.
output_examples.output: A focused diagram that groups VNets, subnets, private endpoints, NSGs, compute resources, and connected data services.

output_examples.input: Prepare documentation for an Azure architecture review.
output_examples.output: A structured review document with resource details, major dependencies, security notes, and recommendations for follow-up validation.

best_practices: Run the skill with least-privilege read access to the target Azure subscription.
Review generated diagrams for sensitive names, IP ranges, tags, and identity details before sharing.
Use separate diagrams for very large resource groups to keep the output readable.
anti_patterns: Do not include secret values, keys, connection strings, or Key Vault secret contents in diagrams.
Do not run the skill against subscriptions that are outside the approved review scope.
Do not treat generated relationships as final without validating ambiguous dependencies.

faq.question: Does this skill modify Azure resources?
faq.answer: No. The instructions are for read-only analysis and documentation. It explicitly says not to modify or delete Azure resources.

faq.question: What tools does it use?
faq.answer: It can use Azure MCP tools, Azure CLI, and Azure Resource Graph guidance when those tools are available.

faq.question: Can it create Mermaid diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed to create Mermaid diagrams with resource groups, layers, labels, and relationships.

faq.question: Will it include secrets?
faq.answer: It instructs the assistant to use placeholders for secret values and never put actual secrets in diagrams.

faq.question: Can it handle large environments?
faq.answer: Yes, but it recommends multiple diagrams for complex architectures with many resources.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Cloud engineers, application owners, and architects can use it to document Azure resource group architecture.
